sentences.text: Tiiliruukin Vesi ja Viemäri Oy is a company registered on 2026-04-20 under the industry code 36000, water collection, treatment and supply.
First sales, a start-up notification and a board change are all dated 2026-08-31.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but a local water utility is not a venture on its own evidence.
